senses.meaning: Ngành hàng không; việc bay máy bay
examples: She has always dreamed of a career in aviation.
Advances in aviation technology have made flights safer and more efficient.
The aviation industry was severely affected by the pandemic.
He has worked as a civil servant in the tax department for twenty years.
Civil servants must remain politically neutral in their duties.
The reforms were unpopular among senior civil servants.
The receptionist greeted every guest with a warm smile.
Please check in with the receptionist when you arrive.
She worked as a hotel receptionist for three years before being promoted.

senses.meaning: Kiểm soát viên tài chính, kế toán trưởng (chức danh chính thức)
examples: The comptroller's office oversees the city's entire budget.
She was appointed as the state comptroller last year.
The comptroller reported a significant deficit in the annual accounts.

note: Chủ yếu dùng trong bộ máy nhà nước và chính phủ Mỹ. Phát âm giống 'controller'.

senses.meaning: Thuộc về thú y, liên quan đến y học động vật
examples: She is studying at a veterinary school.
The dog received prompt veterinary care after the accident.
Veterinary science has advanced significantly in recent decades.

senses.meaning: Bác sĩ thú y (viết tắt, informal)
examples: I need to take my cat to the veterinary.
The veterinary examined the horse's injured leg carefully.
Our local veterinary is very experienced with exotic animals.

note: Dạng đầy đủ là 'veterinarian'; 'vet' là viết tắt thông dụng nhất.

senses.meaning: Trung úy (quân đội); phó, người thừa lệnh trong tổ chức
examples: He was promoted to the rank of lieutenant last year.
The lieutenant passed on the general's orders to the troops.
As his lieutenant, she handled all the day-to-day operations.

note: Phát âm tiếng Anh Mỹ: /luːˈtenənt/; tiếng Anh Anh: /lefˈtenənt/.

senses.meaning: Giám sát, quản lý (công việc hoặc nhân viên)
examples: She was hired to supervise the construction project.
He supervised a team of twenty employees.
Teachers must supervise students carefully during exam sessions.

senses.meaning: Đưa ra khỏi hoạt động chính thức (tàu, nhà máy, vũ khí, vệ tinh)
examples: The aging nuclear plant was decommissioned last year.
Several warships were decommissioned after the peace treaty was signed.
The satellite will be decommissioned when its fuel runs out.

senses.meaning: Lần ra mắt đầu tiên, lần xuất hiện lần đầu trước công chúng
examples: The singer made her debut at Carnegie Hall at just eighteen.
His film debut was a box office success.
The product's debut was eagerly anticipated by consumers worldwide.

senses.meaning: Ra mắt, xuất hiện lần đầu
examples: The band debuted their new album at a sold-out concert.
She debuted as a film director with a low-budget thriller.
The smartphone model debuted at a major tech conference in Berlin.

note: Gốc tiếng Pháp. Phát âm cả 'debut' /ˈdeɪbjuː/ và 'début' đều đúng.
